nodes.statement: Daftardar-Gejji and Jafari Method Daftardar-Gejji and Jafari Method (DJM) is one of the popular methods applied to solve nonlinear equations . It is simple as compared with other methods. However, it gives more accurate solutions . It is also used to solve algebraic and differential equations. Suppose that given problem can be transformed to the model equation u= f + L(u) + N(u), where L and N are linear and nonlinear operators respectively and f is known function.\\ In this case, the DJM provides the solution in the form of series u= sum_i=0^infty u_i. where u_0=f,\; u_1=N(u_0)\; and u_n+1 = Nleft(sum_j=0^n u_jright)- Nleft(sum_j=0^n-1 u_jright), n=1, 2, cdots. \\ Usually, the k-term approximate solution u= sum_i=0^k-1 u_i is used to approximate the exact solution.

nodes.statement: Delay differential equations (DDE) are the systems where the rate of change of function depend on its values at past time. Such equations are proved more realistic than ordinary differential equations (ODE) because they can model memory in the system. Due to the transcendental nature of characteristic equation of DDE, it is more difficult to analyze as compared with ODE. Analysis of DDEs is discussed in . DDEs with impulses are considered in . State dependent and time dependent delays are analyzed by Winston and Burton respectively. A more general case of nonlinear DDE is discussed in by Bhalekar. Safonov et al used a second order DDE in car-following traffic model. Hutchinson proposed a delayed logistic equation to model population dynamics. Ikeda equation is a DDE used in nonlinear optics. In , Villermaux showed that the oscillations in unsteady recirculating flows can be modeled by using a DDE. The theory of bifurcation in DDE is very useful in analyzing the fluctuations in economic activities . The delayed feedback controllers are developed by Masoud et al which are useful in mechanical engineering. These equations can also be used to describe infectious diseases . Bhalekar and coworkers described fractional order bloch equation arising in NMR. If the equations are with variable coefficients then we may get Legendre polynomial, Lagarre polynomial, Bessel functions and so on .
